prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Your Desktop Companion is Ready!", "Learn how to command, hide, or chat with your new pet anytime from your system tray or hotkeys.", "Essential Desktop Controls", "Right-click pet for menu • Press Alt+P to hide • Drag anywhere to move", "Start Desktop Session"]
1: ["Welcome Your New Companion!", "Give your new pet a warm welcome to prepare them for their new home on your desktop.", "Complete Adoption Ritual"]
2: ["Preparing Your Desktop Workspace", "We are calibrating screen overlays and loading pet animations for your desktop environment.", "System Check Status", "Desktop Overlay Engine • System Tray Integration • Pet Animation Assets", "Finalizing desktop integration..."]
3: ["Choose Your Companion Experience", "Explore different pet personalities and play styles before selecting your path.", "Experience Types", "Relaxed Desktop Companion vs Active Play Buddy", "Continue to Path Selection", "Select Your Journey Path", "Pick the path that best matches how you want to interact with your pet on your desktop."]
4: ["Signing in automatically syncs and restores your saved pets and progress from cloud storage.", "Cloud Sync Active", "Your existing pets and items are safe and ready to restore."]
5: ["Photo analysis takes about 30 seconds. Ensure high contrast and clear lighting for best visual outcome.", "Generation Tips", "Clear front-facing photos produce the sharpest 3D pet models."]
6: ["Tip: Look for the pet icon in your system tray to adjust visibility, volume, or open pet chat anytime.", "Quick Tip", "Right-click system tray icon to hide pet or access settings instantly."]
7: ["Select Your Preferred Experience (Change Anytime)", "Don't worry—you can adjust your pet's play style and notification frequency later in Settings."]
8: ["Feel free to minimize this window. We'll alert you as soon as your pet is ready on your desktop.", "Background Ready", "We will notify you on desktop when complete."]
9: ["Official Adoption Certificate & Starter Gift", "Bonus Unlocked", "Free Starter Toy Pack included with your adoption certificate!"]
